context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Chat feature is fully functional. Backend APIs all working. Frontend had two bugs that were fixed: 1) process.env usage (changed to getApiUrl()), 2) auth loading race condition (added authLoading check). The page loads correctly with all UI elements. Cloudflare rate limiting blocked extended automated testing but manual verification confirmed functionality.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause_1: AIChatPage.jsx used process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL at module level (line 37), but 'process' is not defined in browser context with Vite. Other files use import.meta.env or getApiUrl() from @/lib/api.
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause_2: AIChatPage.jsx checked isAuthenticated and redirected to /login before AuthContext finished loading (authLoading was true). This caused premature redirects.
fixes_applied: Changed const API = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to const API = getApiUrl()
Added authLoading from useAuth() and check if (authLoading) return in useEffect
Added loading UI while auth initializes: if (authLoading || (!token && !isAuthenticated)) return loading spinner
